purpose: The full list of requirements from the request, one row each, with what was delivered, where it lives, and an honest status. Nothing is marked DONE unless it is on the site and reproducible.

status_key.DONE: delivered, on the site, reproducible from checked-in code
status_key.DONE - NEGATIVE RESULT: the analysis was completed and the answer is 'no'; that is the deliverable
status_key.PARTIAL: delivered in part; the missing part is named
status_key.BLOCKED: cannot be delivered with the sources available; stated as a flag with the reason

requirements.requirement: Review the repository
requirements.delivered: Full inventory: file counts, HTML page count, size hotspots, conflict-marker scan, tracked .pyc files, and a file-by-file verdict on the four existing NFL workspaces.

requirements.requirement: Work line by line, verify from official trusted sources, provide links, no hallucinations
requirements.delivered: Every table row on every page carries a source URL. 15 mechanical integrity checks must pass or the build refuses. Values that cannot be confirmed are blank, never inferred.

requirements.requirement: Flag irregularities for review
requirements.delivered: 16 flagged items on a dedicated page, each with severity, what was found, and whether it blocks publication.

requirements.requirement: Make suggestions to improve decision making
requirements.delivered: 16 suggested changes with impact, effort, risk, prerequisites and current status, so a path can be chosen before anything is implemented.

requirements.requirement: Create a section dedicated to suggestions for review before implementing changes
requirements.delivered: The Suggestions page. Each item shows status (implemented / proposed / needs decision) and the questions that must be answered first.

requirements.requirement: A clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision
requirements.delivered: 22 questions in four states (answered / partial / open / blocked), each split into what we know, what we do not know, the answer, and what would unlock it; plus 7 decisions and exactly which questions block each.

requirements.requirement: Suggest ways to discover the missing information
requirements.delivered: Each OPEN/BLOCKED question names what would unlock it (a licence, a daily capture, an owner decision); each suggestion names its prerequisites.

requirements.requirement: Originate my own NFL lines
requirements.delivered: Own spread, total, home/away points and fair moneyline for all 14 official Week 10 games, built only from official NFL.com team statistics.

requirements.requirement: Research and develop strategies for generating useful signals
requirements.delivered: A 10-signal catalogue with an explicit verdict per signal, plus 4 strategies actually backtested. Signals we could not measure are listed as not measured rather than invented.

requirements.requirement: Leaderboard competition with rewards for top performers
requirements.delivered: Tiered leaderboard (Qualified / Bronze / Rejected) with a 1,000-point non-monetary pool. 0 of 4 strategies qualify, so 0 points are awarded.

requirements.requirement: Look at single bets
requirements.delivered: Three single-bet strategies (spread divergence, total divergence, fair-moneyline value) graded on 2,383 holdout games.

requirements.requirement: Look at parlays
requirements.delivered: Cross-game 2-leg parlays built from the strongest single legs each week, priced at the true two-leg payout. n=155, ROI -15.74%.

requirements.requirement: Look at player prop bet combos
requirements.delivered: Explained precisely why it cannot be graded here: no official player-game logs and no prop prices in scope. Correlation cells left blank; gate G9 fails by construction.

requirements.requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates
requirements.delivered: 10 pre-registered gates applied unchanged to every strategy, with per-gate pass/fail and the reason.

requirements.requirement: Determine correlation values
requirements.delivered: Two team-level dependence pairs measured with phi coefficients on 2,383 games (both near zero), plus residual persistence +0.40. Player-level correlations are BLOCKED and blank.

requirements.requirement: Remove luck from the equation
requirements.delivered: Luck is bounded, not removed: week-clustered bootstrap, matched-random placebo permutation, season-stability, residual persistence. Each is reported with its value.

requirements.requirement: Build strategies that are selectively skill based
requirements.delivered: The skill test is operationalised (G4 market bar, G5 CI bound, G6 placebo, G7 stability, G8 replication). No strategy passes, and the page says so rather than relabelling noise as skill.

requirements.requirement: Track injuries
requirements.delivered: All 275 players listed on the official Week 10 report across the 28 clubs playing, with position, injury, practice status and game status.

requirements.requirement: Know deficiencies where 2nd/3rd/4th-string defenders or backups replace starters
requirements.delivered: The question was researched to its root: nfl.com publishes no depth chart (the depth-chart URL 404s) and no snap counts. The page shows unavailability by position instead, and never asserts who is a backup.

requirements.requirement: Same for offense (starters vs backups)
requirements.delivered: Same as R19 for offensive positions; notable confirmed absences are listed without starter/backup labels.

requirements.requirement: Create an executive summary outlining important details
requirements.delivered: A one-page executive summary of what was built, what the evidence says, what is blocked, and what to do next.

requirements.requirement: No manual input from the owner; work autonomously in this session
requirements.delivered: Every dataset, model, gate, page and check was produced in this session; the build is one command and runs with the Python standard library only.

requirements.requirement: Create a GitHub Pages live site, clean landing page, subpages by category, table format
requirements.delivered: 14 pages: dashboard plus categories (official data, own lines, strategies, competition, availability, decision support, governance), all in table form with a filter box.

requirements.requirement: Every table row must have a source link; blank + flag if unverified
requirements.delivered: Enforced mechanically: the site build exits non-zero if any table row lacks an http(s) source link.

requirements.requirement: Read COORDINATION.md, claim the task, avoid conflicts with parallel sessions
requirements.delivered: Claim committed and pushed before work started; peer NFL/NBA/rental namespaces read-only; only append-only board/README text and one additive root link touched.

requirements.requirement: Open a PR, merge without waiting, confirm Pages deploy, record the receipt
requirements.delivered: PR opened from this branch, merged to main, Pages deployment confirmed by fetching the live URL, and the PR link plus merge commit recorded in COORDINATION.md.
